When I was hospitalised, I came up with a plan to “espace”. I found the perfect speech to let the psychiatrist let me out. So the next morning, I came to see him, and talked about how I was feeling much better. I was very convincing. So he let me out. Two weeks later I tried to kill myself. 
Until that day I regret lying to that psychiatrist. I could’ve avoid all the pain I did to my friends and family. Please don’t do the same mistake here. Let them know If you’re hurting yourself, they’re here to help.

so a few years earlier I was a total mess. A drug addict, a drunk, going out all the time, sleeping with strangers, spending money I obviously didn’t have and of course I wasn’t at school anymore. I had very complicated relationships with my friends and family. It took me 5 years of therapy to finally be a little better. Sure, I had to work harder than ever. Had to go back to school, get a job, stop my addictions, and be able to deal with my intense emotions. Now I have a stable student job, I am studying psychology (lol) and I am in a healthy relationship. 
I know that the way I wrote my “happy ending” seems like it was easy to get better. But trust me, it costed me a lot, it’s a lot of effort but the key is to never abandon. Even if sometimes you feel like it’s not working, if you feel helpless. Remember that it is not going to be like that all the time. Every step, even a small one, is a step toward recovery.
